title: A cikin daji
description: Ten stories in the open air: a salt caravan crossing the desert to Bilma, three friends camping by a lake near Jos, fishermen back on Lake Chad after the militants were driven out, monkeys raiding a grandmother's mango farm, a bear on a hiking trail in Germany, the old dye pits of Kano, pilgrims under the sky at Arafat, a hunter who clears an old woman of witchcraft, a customs post in the bush on the night of a football match, and a widow who leaves her mourning to take her daughter-in-law through the flood to the clinic.

lessons.title: Ayari a cikin hamada
lessons.summary: Young Kailani joins the salt caravan from Agadez to Bilma; his father entrusts him to Rhissa, the experienced caravan leader, who forecasts a sandstorm on a clear day; in the storm Kailani is lost in bewilderment and Rhissa calms him without a word; they reach Bilma and Rhissa returns the boy to his father.
lessons.text:
Kailani matashi ne daga Agadez. Kakansa da mahaifinsa duk sun yi tafiya da ayarin raƙuma zuwa Bilma domin sayo gishiri. A bana Kailani ya ce shi ma yana so ya shiga ayarin. Mahaifinsa ya kai shi wurin Rhissa, madugun ayarin.

Rhissa gogaggen madugu ne. Ya shafe shekara talatin yana jagorantar ayari a cikin hamada. Mahaifin Kailani ya ce masa, "Na danƙa maka ɗana. Ka kula da shi kamar ɗanka." Rhissa ya ce, "Na karɓi amanarka. Duk wanda aka danƙa mini, zan dawo da shi lafiya."

Kafin su tashi, mata sun shirya musu guzuri: kilishi, dabino, garin gero da ruwa. Kilishi ba ya lalacewa da sauri, saboda haka matafiya a hamada suna son sa sosai. Kailani ya cika jakarsa da kilishi.

Ayarin ya tashi da sanyin safiya. Raƙuma hamsin ne, mutane takwas. Kwana uku na farko hanyar tsakuwa ce. Tsakuwa tana ƙara a ƙarƙashin ƙafafun raƙuma, kuma rana tana zafi sosai. Daga baya tsakuwa ta ƙare, yashi ya fara.

A rana ta biyar Rhissa ya tsaya, ya kalli sama da kuma iska. Ya ce, "Tsinkayata ita ce iska mai ƙarfi za ta taso kafin yamma, za ta ɗauko yashi." Kailani ya yi mamaki, domin sama tana da haske. Amma wani tsoho a cikin ayarin ya ce masa, "Tsinkayar Rhissa ba ta taɓa kuskure ba. Gogaggen madugu yana karanta hamada kamar littafi."

Kafin la'asar iskar ta taso kamar yadda madugun ya yi tsinkaya. Yashi ya rufe sama, rana ta ɓace. Kowa ya zaunar da raƙuminsa, ya rufe fuskarsa da rawani. Kailani ya shiga ɗimuwa. Bai san inda yake ba, bai ga kowa ba, ya ji kamar zai yi kuka. A cikin ɗimuwarsa, sai ya ji hannun Rhissa a kafaɗarsa. Madugun bai ce uffan ba. Ya zaunar da shi kusa da raƙumi kawai, ya rufe masa kai da bargo, ya riƙe hannunsa.

Iskar ta yi awa biyu tana busawa. Da ta lafa, kowa ya fito, yana karkaɗe yashi daga jikinsa. Kailani ya tambayi Rhissa, "Me ya sa ba ka ce mini uffan ba a lokacin?" Rhissa ya yi murmushi ya ce, "A cikin irin wannan iska, magana ba ta da amfani. Idan ka buɗe baki, yashi zai shiga. Hannu ya fi baki a lokacin ɗimuwa."

Bayan kwana goma sha biyu suka isa Bilma. Suka sayi gishiri da dabino, suka ci kilishinsu na ƙarshe, suka koma. Da suka dawo Agadez, Rhissa ya ce wa mahaifin Kailani, "Ga ɗanka da ka danƙa mini. Yanzu ya zama ɗan ayari na gaske."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa ayarin yake zuwa Bilma?
Ayarin yana zuwa Bilma domin sayo gishiri.
Wa mahaifin Kailani ya danƙa wa ɗansa?
Ya danƙa shi ga Rhissa, gogaggen madugun ayarin.
Me ya sa matafiya a hamada suke son kilishi?
Domin kilishi ba ya lalacewa da sauri.
Yaya hanyar take a kwana uku na farko?
Hanyar tsakuwa ce, kuma rana tana zafi sosai.
Me Rhissa ya yi lokacin da Kailani ya shiga ɗimuwa?
Bai ce uffan ba; ya zaunar da shi kusa da raƙumi, ya rufe masa kai da bargo.

lessons.title: Zango a gefen tafki
lessons.summary: Three friends from Jos camp for a weekend by a lake: lazy Bakoji brings a mattress too big for the tent, Dalha charges the phones from a solar panel, they spray against mosquitoes and wear long-sleeved shirts, Kamalu's snoring and Bakoji's farting keep the tent awake, and in the morning a rain shower stands in for the shower they do not have.
lessons.text:
Dalha, Kamalu da Bakoji abokai ne tun suna makarantar firamare. Duk shekara sukan fita daga Jos su yi zango na kwana biyu a gefen wani tafki a cikin daji. Dalha ne yake shirya komai, domin Bakoji malalaci ne. Idan aka ce a ɗauki kaya, sai ya ce ƙafarsa tana ciwo.

A bana Bakoji ya ce zai kawo nasa kayan. Da suka isa tafkin, sai suka ga ya zo da babbar katifa ta soso. Dalha ya ce, "Bakoji, wannan katifa ba za ta shiga tanti ba!" Bakoji ya ce, "Ni ba zan kwana a ƙasa ba. Malalaci yana son jin daɗi." Suka yi ta dariya. Daga ƙarshe suka shimfiɗa katifar a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya kusa da tanti.

Dalha ya kawo ƙaramin allon hasken rana. Ya ɗora shi a kan dutse, ya ce, "Duk wanda yake so ya caza wayarsa, ya kawo ta nan." Kamalu ya caza wayarsa, Bakoji ma ya caza tasa, amma ya bar ta a rana har ta yi zafi sosai.

Da yamma sauro ya fito daga cikin ciyawar tafkin. Kamalu ya fito da maganin sauro, ya fesa a hannunsa da wuyansa. Ya fesa wa abokansa ma. Dalha ya ce kowa ya sa taguwa mai dogon hannu da dogon wando. Bakoji ya ce ba shi da taguwa mai dogon hannu, sai Dalha ya ba shi tasa. Taguwar ta yi masa girma, amma ya ce hakan ya fi cizon sauro.

Bayan sun ci abinci, Bakoji ya yi tambaya: "Shin kifi yana barci?" Sai shi da kansa ya ce, "Na san wannan sakaran tambaya ce." Kamalu ya ce, "Babu sakaran tambaya. Ina ji kifi yana hutawa, amma ba ya rufe idanunsa."

Da dare suka kwanta. Ba a jima ba Kamalu ya fara minshari. Minsharinsa ya yi ƙarfi har tsuntsaye suka tashi daga bishiya. Bakoji ya ce, "Wannan minshari kamar inji!" Ana nan sai Bakoji kuma ya yi tusa, domin ya ci wake da yawa. Dalha ya buɗe tanti da sauri. Ya ce, "Bakoji, tusar nan ta fi minsharin Kamalu wahala!" Duk suka yi dariya har Kamalu ya farka.

Da safe Dalha ya ce, "Ina shawa?" Babu shawa a cikin daji, sai ruwan tafki. Suna cikin magana, sai ruwan sama ya fara sauka. Bakoji ya fito ya tsaya a ciki, ya ce, "Ga shawa daga Allah!" Shi ma Kamalu ya fito. Ruwan shawar ya yi minti goma, sannan rana ta fito. Bakoji ya koma kan katifarsa, ya kwanta. Malalaci ko a zango ba ya canzawa.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Dalha ne yake shirya komai?
Domin Bakoji malalaci ne.
Ina suka shimfiɗa katifar Bakoji?
Sun shimfiɗa ta a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya kusa da tanti.
Yaya suka caza wayoyinsu?
Sun caza su da ƙaramin allon hasken rana.
Me Kamalu ya fesa a hannunsa?
Ya fesa maganin sauro a hannunsa da wuyansa.
Me ya hana su barci da dare?
Minsharin Kamalu da tusar Bakoji sun hana su barci.
Wace tambaya Bakoji ya ce sakaran tambaya ce?
Ya tambaya ko kifi yana barci.

lessons.title: Masunta sun koma tafki
lessons.summary: Kolo, an old fisherman on Lake Chad, takes his nephew Abatcha out after soldiers with cannons and rockets cleared the militants from the islands; they drop anchor, bait hooks, and a huge fish nearly sinks their canoe, splashing water everywhere, until Kolo catches the handle of the basket and they bring it home.
lessons.text:
Kolo masunci ne a gefen Tafkin Chadi. Ya yi kamun kifi tun yana ƙarami, kamar mahaifinsa da kakansa. Amma shekaru goma da suka wuce tsagera suka zo suka kafa sansani a tsibiran tafkin. Tsageran sukan kama masunta, su karɓe kifinsu da kwalekwalensu. Saboda haka Kolo da sauran masunta suka bar tafkin, suka koma cikin gari.

Daga baya sojoji suka zo. Kolo ya tuna da dare yana jin ƙarar igwa da ta rokoki daga cikin tafkin. Sojoji suna harba rokoki a sansanin tsagera, igwa kuma tana girgiza ƙasa. Bayan watanni da yawa sojojin suka kakkaɓe tsagera daga tsibiran da suke kusa da garin. A bana gwamnati ta ce masunta za su iya komawa tafkin.

Kolo ya ɗauki ɗan ƙanwarsa Abatcha, mai shekara goma sha shida. Suka shiga kwalekwale da sanyin safiya. Da suka kai tsakiyar ruwa, Kolo ya jefa anga. Ya ce, "Anga tana riƙe kwalekwale a wuri ɗaya, don kada ruwa ya tafi da shi." Sannan ya fito da igiya mai ƙugiya da yawa. Ya koya wa Abatcha yadda ake sa abinci a jikin ƙugiya. "Kada ka bar ƙugiya ta shiga hannunka," in ji shi. "Ƙugiya ba ta san bambancin kifi da mutum ba."

Bayan awa ɗaya, sai igiyar ta yi nauyi. Wani babban kifi ya kama ƙugiya. Kifin ya fara jan kwalekwale, ruwa yana fantsama ko'ina. Ruwan ya fantsama a fuskar Abatcha da kuma cikin kwalekwalen. Abatcha ya yi ihu, "Kawu, kifin nan zai nutsar da mu!" Kolo ya ce, "Kada ka ji tsoro. Ka riƙe madaukin kwando, ni kuma zan ja igiya."

Kwalekwalen ya karkata, ruwa ya ƙara shiga. Abatcha ya riƙe madaukin kwando da hannu biyu. Kolo ya ja igiyar a hankali har kifin ya gaji. Daga ƙarshe suka ɗaga shi suka sa a cikin kwando. Ya fi Abatcha nauyi. Kolo ya ce, "Ka gani, ruwa ba zai nutsar da mai haƙuri ba."

Abatcha ya tashi tsaye, ya kakkaɓe ruwa daga rigarsa, ya yi dariya. Kolo ya ɗaga anga, suka koma gida. Mutanen gari suka taru suna kallon kifin. Wani tsoho ya ce, "Shekaru goma ba mu ga irin wannan kifi ba. Lokacin tsagera, ƙarar igwa ta kori kifi da masunta duka."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Kolo ya bar tafkin shekaru goma da suka wuce?
Domin tsagera sun kafa sansani a tsibiran tafkin, suna kama masunta.
Me sojoji suka yi?
Sun harba rokoki da igwa, suka kakkaɓe tsagera daga tsibiran.
Me ya sa Kolo ya jefa anga?
Domin anga tana riƙe kwalekwale a wuri ɗaya.
Me Abatcha ya ji tsoro?
Ya ji tsoron kifin zai nutsar da su.
Me Abatcha ya riƙe?
Ya riƙe madaukin kwando da hannu biyu.
Me ya faru da ruwa lokacin da kifin ya ja kwalekwale?
Ruwa ya fantsama ko'ina, har a fuskar Abatcha.

lessons.title: Birai a gonar kaka
lessons.summary: Ubaida spends the hot season on his grandmother Uwaliya's farm near Zaria: they sprinkle the watermelon seedlings, dig cassava and pile up mangoes, but monkeys come to loot and waste the fruit out of greed; Ubaida eats too many mangoes and learns his grandmother's lesson about greed.
lessons.text:
Kowane lokacin zafi Ubaida yakan je gonar kakarsa Uwaliya a wajen Zaria. Gonar tana da bishiyoyin mangwaro guda ashirin, da wurin kankana, da kuma rogo mai yawa. Uwaliya ta ce, "A gonar nan ba a rasa abinci. Idan mangwaro bai nuna ba, rogo yana nan."

Da safe Uwaliya da Ubaida sukan je wurin kankana. Ƙananan kankana suna fitowa daga ƙasa, kuma rana tana ƙona su. Uwaliya ta koya wa Ubaida yadda ake yayyafa musu ruwa. "Kada ka zuba ruwa da yawa a lokaci ɗaya," in ji ta. "Ka yayyafa shi a hankali, kamar ruwan sama na farko." Ubaida ya ɗauki kwano ya yayyafa ruwa a kan kowace kankana.

Da rana suka je su ciro rogo. Uwaliya ta ce, "Rogo yana ɓoye a ƙasa, amma idan ka gan shi, ka ga abinci na wata guda." Suka ciro rogo suka kai gida don a yi gari.

Bayan haka suka tsinci mangwaro. Ubaida ya hau bishiya, yana jefa mangwaro ƙasa, kakarsa kuma tana tara su. Daga ƙarshe suka yi wani babban tulin mangwaro a ƙarƙashin bishiya. Uwaliya ta ƙirga su ƙwara ɗaya ɗaya. Ta ce, "Ƙwara ɗari da hamsin ke nan. Gobe za mu kai kasuwa."

Washegari da sassafe sai suka ji ƙara a gona. Birai goma sun zo, suna wawushe mangwaro daga tulin. Kowane biri yana kama ƙwara biyu ko uku, yana cizon ɗaya, sannan ya jefar da shi, ya ɗauki wani. Ubaida ya yi ihu, birai suka gudu zuwa cikin daji. Amma sun riga sun ɓarnata rabin tulin.

Uwaliya ta ce, "Ka ga haɗamar biri? Ba ya cin abin da ya ɗauka, sai ɓarnata shi. Haka mutum mai haɗama yake: yana wawushe abin da ba zai iya ci ba, yana ɓarnata na wasu." Ubaida ya ce, "Kaka, ni ba ni da haɗama."

Da yamma Ubaida ya zauna a gefen tulin, yana cin mangwaro. Ya ci ƙwara ɗaya, biyu, uku, har ya ci goma. Da dare cikinsa ya fara ciwo. Kakarsa ta ba shi ruwan zafi, ta ce, "Kwaɗayi mabuɗin wahala. Yau ka ga haɗama ba ta biri kaɗai ba ce." Ubaida ya yi dariya duk da ciwon cikinsa.

Tambayoyi:
Me ke cikin gonar Uwaliya?
Akwai bishiyoyin mangwaro, wurin kankana da rogo mai yawa.
Yaya ake yayyafa ruwa a kan kankana?
Ana yayyafa shi a hankali, kamar ruwan sama na farko.
Ƙwara nawa ne a cikin tulin mangwaro?
Ƙwara ɗari da hamsin ne.
Me birai suka yi da safe?
Sun wawushe mangwaro daga tulin, suka ɓarnata rabinsa.
Me ya sa cikin Ubaida ya yi ciwo?
Domin ya ci mangwaro ƙwara goma saboda haɗama.

lessons.title: Beyar a kan hanya
lessons.summary: Fadwa, a Hausa student in Germany, hikes in the southern mountains with her friend Lena; a ranger in uniform warns them in German not to walk alone because a bear has been seen; Fadwa, distracted by her phone, falls behind, meets the bear, stretches out her arms and talks calmly until it leaves, and Lena consoles her.
lessons.text:
Fadwa ɗaliba ce daga Najeriya da take karatu a Jamus. Shekararta ta farko ta yi ta koyon Jamusanci, kuma yanzu tana iya magana da mutane. Ƙawarta Lena ta gayyace ta zuwa wani babban daji a kan duwatsu a kudancin ƙasar.

A farkon hanyar wani mutum ne tsaye cikin koren unifom. Sunansa Becker, mai gadin dajin ne. Ya yi musu magana da Jamusanci, Lena tana fassara wasu kalmomi. Ya ce, "Wannan makon an ga beyar a kusa da hanya. Kada ku kaɗaita. Ku yi tafiya tare, ku riƙa magana da ƙarfi." Ya nuna musu wata alama a jikin bishiya. Alamar tana da hoton beyar, kuma saƙonta bayyananne ne: a yi hankali. Becker ya ce, "Wannan unifom da nake sawa alama ce cewa ni ma'aikacin dajin ne. Idan kuka ga wani mai irin wannan unifom, ku faɗa masa duk abin da kuka gani."

Suka fara hawan dutsen. Iska tana da sanyi, bishiyoyi suna da tsawo sosai. Da suka kai saman wani tudu, Lena ta ce, "Ki yi kira!" Fadwa ta yi kira da ƙarfi, "Sannu!" Sai amsa kuwwa ta dawo daga ɗayan gefen dutsen: "Sannu... sannu..." Fadwa ta yi dariya. Lena ta ce, "A Jamusanci ma kuwwa tana amsawa da Hausa!"

Bayan haka Fadwa ta fito da wayarta. Furanni masu launi iri iri suna gefen hanya, kuma ta so ta ɗauki hotunansu. Hotunan sun shagaltar da ita har ba ta lura cewa Lena ta yi nisa ba. Ta kaɗaita a kan hanya ba tare da ta sani ba.

Sai ta ji wani motsi a cikin bishiyoyi. Ta ɗaga kai, ta ga beyar tsaye a kan hanya, ba ta da nisa. Gabanta ya faɗi. Amma ta tuna da maganar Becker: kada ki gudu. Ta tsaya, ta miƙar da hannuwanta sama domin ta yi kamar babba. Ta riƙa magana a hankali da Hausa, "Ki tafi, ki tafi, ba na son faɗa." Beyar ta kalle ta, sannan ta juya ta shiga cikin daji.

Fadwa ta fara rawar jiki. Lena ta dawo da gudu, ta rungume ta. Ta yi ta lallashinta, "Kada ki damu. Abin da kika yi daidai ne, kuma jarumtaka ce." Lallashin Lena ya kwantar mata da hankali, kuma ta ci gaba da lallashinta har suka sauka.

Da suka dawo, suka faɗa wa Becker. Ya ce wa Lena, "Ta miƙar da hannuwanta, ba ta gudu ba? Wannan ita ce hanya mafi kyau." Sannan ya juya ga Fadwa, ya ce, "Amma kada wayarki ta sake shagaltar da ke a cikin daji." Fadwa ta ce, "Na koyi darasi bayyananne: a daji, ido ya fi waya."

Tambayoyi:
Da wane harshe Becker ya yi musu magana?
Ya yi musu magana da Jamusanci.
Me ya sa Becker ya ce kada su kaɗaita?
Domin an ga beyar a kusa da hanya a wannan makon.
Me ya faru lokacin da Fadwa ta yi kira a saman tudu?
Kuwwa ta dawo daga ɗayan gefen dutsen.
Me ya shagaltar da Fadwa?
Hotunan furanni sun shagaltar da ita.
Me Fadwa ta yi lokacin da ta ga beyar?
Ta tsaya, ta miƙar da hannuwanta sama, ta riƙa magana a hankali.
Wane darasi bayyananne Fadwa ta koya?
Ta koyi cewa a daji, ido ya fi waya.

lessons.title: Ramukan rina na Kano
lessons.summary: A reporter visits the old dye pits of Kano and talks to Malam Ɗanfillo, the master dyer: the oral tradition of the pits' age, the system of family-owned pits, dyers who pawned their pits in hard times, the scale he weighs ash on, the blue cloth once sent across the Sahara, and a debate between young and old dyers that he sums up with a proverb.
lessons.text:
A makon jiya na je Ƙofar Mata a Kano, inda ake rina zane tun ɗaruruwan shekaru. A wurin akwai ramuka da yawa a cikin ƙasa, a sararin sama, kowanne cike da ruwan rina mai launin shuɗi mai duhu.

Na sami Malam Ɗanfillo, wani tsoho mai shekara saba'in. Mutanen wurin sun ce min shi ne fasihin rina a wannan zamani. Fasihi ne wanda ya san komai game da aikin, tun daga haɗa ruwan rina har zuwa busar da zane. Matasa da yawa suna zuwa wurinsa su koya, domin fasihi irinsa ba ya da yawa.

Malam Ɗanfillo ya ba ni tarihin wurin. Ya ce, "Ruwayar da muka gada daga kakanninmu ta ce an haƙa ramukan farko fiye da shekara ɗari biyar da suka wuce." Na tambaye shi ko akwai rubutu a kan haka. Ya ce, "Ruwaya ce ta baka. Uba yana faɗa wa ɗa, ɗa yana faɗa wa jika."

Sannan ya bayyana min nizamin wurin. Kowane rami na wani gida ne, ana gadonsa daga uba zuwa ɗa. "Wannan nizami ya hana faɗa a tsakaninmu," in ji shi. "Kowa ya san ramin da yake nasa." Amma ya ce a lokacin da kasuwa ta lalace, wasu masu rina suka jinginar da ramukansu ga masu kuɗi don su sami abinci. "Mutumin da ya jinginar da ramin kakansa yana jin kunya," in ji shi, "amma yunwa ba ta jin kunya."

Na kalli yadda yake aiki. Ya auna toka da ganyen wani tsiro a kan wani tsohon mizani na ƙarfe. "Idan mizani bai yi daidai ba, launin ba zai yi kyau ba," ya ce. Mizanin nan na kakansa ne. Ya saka farin zane a cikin rami, ya juya shi da sanda, sannan ya fito da shi. Da iska ta taɓa zanen, sai launinsa ya koma shuɗi.

Zanen da ake rina a nan ana yin suttura da shi, kamar riguna da rawuna. A zamanin da, sarakuna da attajirai suna sa wannan suttura mai launin shuɗi, har ana kai ta Agadez da Timbuktu a bayan raƙuma. Yanzu baƙi daga ƙasashen waje ne suka fi sayen sutturar.

A ranar akwai mahawara a tsakanin masu rina a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya. Matasa suna so su riƙa amfani da launin zamani na kasuwa, domin yana da sauri. Tsofaffi kuma suna ganin hakan zai ɓata sunan wurin. Wani matashi ya ce, "Ba za mu iya rayuwa da tsohon nizami kawai ba."

Malam Ɗanfillo ya ɗaga hannu, kowa ya yi shiru. Ya ce, "Bari in nakalto maganar mahaifina. Ya kan ce, 'Da sauran rina a kaba,' wato aiki bai ƙare ba tukuna. Mu ma a nan, da sauran rina a kaba: sai mun haɗa sabon ilimi da ilimin kakanninmu." Na rubuta maganarsa a littafina, kuma ina so in nakalto ta a ƙarshen wannan rahoto.

Tambayoyi:
Ina ake rina zane a Kano?
Ana rina zane a ramukan da suke Ƙofar Mata.
A kan me aka yi mahawara a tsakanin masu rina?
An yi mahawara a kan amfani da launin zamani na kasuwa.
Me ruwayar kakanninsu ta ce game da ramukan?
Ta ce an haƙa ramukan farko fiye da shekara ɗari biyar da suka wuce.
Me ya sa wasu masu rina suka jinginar da ramukansu?
Domin kasuwa ta lalace, suna so su sami abinci.
Me Malam Ɗanfillo ya nakalto daga mahaifinsa?
Ya nakalto maganar hikima, "Da sauran rina a kaba," wato aiki bai ƙare ba.

lessons.title: Rana a filin Arafat
lessons.summary: Ishaq and his wife Amal go on Hajj: their teacher explains the bath before ihram and the obligatory bath of ritual impurity, the prohibitions of ihram, such as uprooting plants in the sanctuary, and the expiation for breaking them; at Arafat, the best time for prayer, Ishaq kills a scorpion near Amal and explains to a worried pilgrim the hadith of the five harmful animals.
lessons.text:
Ishaq da matarsa Amal sun tafi aikin Hajji a bana. Kafin su tashi daga gida, malaminsu ya koya musu ƙa'idojin Hajji a wani taro a masallaci. Ya ce, "Kafin ku ɗaura harami, sunna ce ku yi wanka. Amma idan mutum yana da janaba, wankan ya wajaba a kansa kafin ya yi sallah. Idan babu ruwa, sai ya yi taimama." Ishaq ya rubuta a littafinsa: wankan janaba ya wajaba, wankan harami kuma sunna ne.

Malamin ya kuma bayyana hani da yawa. Bayan an ɗaura harami, akwai hani a kan aske gashi, yanke farce da sanya turare. Akwai kuma hani a kan farauta. "A cikin Haramin Makka," in ji shi, "an hana a sare bishiya ko a tumɓuke ciyawa. Ko ɗan ƙaramin tsiro ne, kada ku tumɓuke shi."

Wani mutum ya tambaya, "Idan mutum ya karya ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan hani fa?" Malamin ya ce, "Sai ya biya kaffara. Kaffarar na iya zama yanka dabba, ko ciyar da miskinai, ko azumi. Amma kada ku ɗauka kaffara wasa ce. Abin da ya wajaba shi ne ku kiyaye hani tun farko."

Bayan kwanaki suka isa Makka. A rana ta tara ga watan Hajji suka tafi filin Arafat tare da miliyoyin mahajjata. Fili ne babba a sararin sama. Malaminsu ya ce, "Ranar Arafat ita ce mafificin lokacin addu'a a shekara. Mafificin abin da za ku yi a nan shi ne ku roƙi Allah."

Ishaq da Amal suka zauna a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya. Rana tana zafi sosai. Amal tana ta addu'a, tana roƙon Allah ya gafarta musu, ya kuma tsare su daga uƙubar kabari da uƙubar wuta. Ishaq ma yana addu'a, yana tuna iyayensa da suka rasu.

Can sai Ishaq ya ga kunama tana tafiya kusa da ƙafar Amal. Ya ɗauki takalminsa da sauri ya kashe ta. Wani mahajjaci daga Masar da yake zaune kusa da su ya ce, "Kai, ba ka san cewa akwai hani a kan kisan dabbobi a harami ba?"

Ishaq ya ce, "An hana farauta, gaskiya ne. Amma Annabi ya faɗi cewa akwai dabbobi biyar da ake kira fasiƙai, waɗanda ake iya kashe su ko a cikin harami: hankaka, shirwa, kunama, ɓera da kare mai cizo. Kowanne daga cikinsu fasiƙi ne, wato mai cutar da mutane." Mutumin ya tambaya, "To, babu kaffara a kan haka?" Ishaq ya ce, "Babu kaffara a kan kashe fasiƙi daga cikin waɗannan dabbobi."

Da rana ta faɗi suka tashi zuwa Muzdalifa. A can suka kwana a ƙasa a ƙarƙashin taurari, kowa yana tattara ƙananan duwatsu don jifa. Amal ta ce, "Ban taɓa kwana a sararin sama irin wannan ba." Ishaq ya ce, "Mu gode wa Allah da ya kawo mu nan."

Tambayoyi:
Wane wanka ne ya wajaba kafin sallah?
Wankan janaba ne ya wajaba kafin sallah.
Wane hani ne yake cikin Haramin Makka?
An hana a sare bishiya ko a tumɓuke ciyawa.
Me mutum zai yi idan ya karya hani?
Zai biya kaffara, kamar yanka dabba, ciyar da miskinai ko azumi.
Me malaminsu ya ce game da ranar Arafat?
Ya ce ita ce mafificin lokacin addu'a a shekara.
Me Amal take roƙon Allah a Arafat?
Tana roƙonsa ya gafarta musu, ya tsare su daga uƙubar kabari da ta wuta.
Me ya sa Ishaq bai biya kaffara ba bayan ya kashe kunama?
Domin kunama tana cikin fasiƙai, dabbobi biyar da ake iya kashewa.

lessons.title: Maharbi da tsohuwa
lessons.summary: Young men mock the old hunter Ɗanyaya for his charms and accuse the lonely old woman Iyatu of witchcraft when goats die for no reason; Ɗanyaya goes into the bush with her groundnut cakes, his tracking fails twice in the rain, then he finds a hyena's den full of goat bones and tells the youths that provoking a weak old woman is no humanity.
lessons.text:
Ɗanyaya tsohon maharbi ne a wani ƙauye a gefen daji. Duk inda zai je, yana ɗaure da laya a hannunsa da wuyansa. Matasan ƙauyen sukan yi masa isgili: "Tsoho, layarka za ta kama maka zomo?" Ɗanyaya ba ya fushi da isgilinsu. Yakan ce, "Laya ba ta kama nama. Ido da haƙuri ne suke kamawa."

A ƙarshen ƙauyen akwai wata tsohuwa mai suna Iyatu, wadda take zaune ita kaɗai. Mijinta ya rasu tun shekaru, 'ya'yanta kuma suna birni. Tana yawan sallah da dare, har wasu mutane suke cewa tana kama da waliyyi. Ɗanyaya ma ya kan ce, "Idan akwai waliyyi a ƙauyen nan, to Iyatu ce."

Wata rana awaki uku na ƙauyen suka mutu a cikin dare ba gaira ba dalili. Washegari kuma wasu biyu suka mutu. Sai matasa suka fara cewa, "Wannan maita ce! Iyatu ce take da maita, domin tana zaune ita kaɗai a gefen daji." Suka je gidanta suka fara tsokane ta. Suna jifan rufin ɗakinta da duwatsu, suna yi mata isgili, suna cewa ta bar ƙauyen.

Ɗanyaya ya ji labarin. Ya je wurin matasan ya ce, "Kada ku zargi mutum da maita ba gaira ba dalili. Ku daina tsokane ta. Ku ba ni kwana uku in shiga daji in nemo abin da yake kashe awakin."

Kafin ya tafi, Iyatu ta kawo masa kuli a cikin wata 'yar jaka. Ta ce, "Ka ci kuli idan yunwa ta kama ka a daji. Allah ya kiyaye ka." Ɗanyaya ya gode mata, ya ɗauki bindigarsa da kulin, ya shiga daji.

A ranar farko bincikensa ya faskara, domin ruwan sama ya goge sawun dabbobi. A rana ta biyu ma ya faskara. Ya zauna a ƙarƙashin bishiya, ya ci kuli, ya sha ruwa. Ya ce a ransa, "Idan wannan karon ma ya faskara, matasan nan za su kori tsohuwa."

A rana ta uku ya ga sawun kura a gefen rafi. Ya bi sawun a hankali har ya kai wani rami a ƙarƙashin duwatsu. A bakin ramin akwai ƙasusuwan awaki. Ashe kura ce take kashe awakin da dare.

Ɗanyaya ya dawo ƙauye ya kira matasan, ya kai su wurin ramin. Ya ce, "Ga abin da yake kashe awakinku: kura ce, ba maita ba. Kun tsokane tsohuwa mai rauni ba gaira ba dalili. Wannan ba mutuntaka ba ce. Mutuntaka ita ce ka kare wanda ba shi da ƙarfi." Matasan suka ji kunya, suka je suka nemi gafarar Iyatu. Ta ce, "Na yafe muku." Sannan ta ba kowannensu kuli.

Daga wannan rana babu wanda ya sake yi wa Ɗanyaya isgili game da layarsa. Shi kuma yakan ce, "Ba laya ce ta kama kura ba, sai haƙuri da mutuntaka."

Tambayoyi:
Me matasan ƙauye suke yi wa Ɗanyaya?
Suna yi masa isgili game da layarsa.
Me ya sa mutane suke cewa Iyatu tana kama da waliyyi?
Domin tana yawan sallah da dare.
Me matasa suka yi bayan awaki sun mutu?
Sun zargi Iyatu da maita, suka je suka tsokane ta.
Me ya sa bincikensa ya faskara a ranar farko?
Domin ruwan sama ya goge sawun dabbobi.
Me Ɗanyaya ya ce mutuntaka take?
Ya ce mutuntaka ita ce ka kare wanda ba shi da ƙarfi.

lessons.title: Dare a ofishin kwastan
lessons.summary: At a bush customs post on the Nigeria–Niger border, Sergeant Soumana watches the new officer Samha's first week; an informant whose name is withheld warns that a smuggler is plotting to cross during the big football match, and while the radio reports a draw Samha finds bags of rice under a cart of china dishes and passes the message on.
lessons.text:
A cikin daji kusa da iyakar Najeriya da Nijar akwai wani ƙaramin ofishin kwastan. Jami'an kwastan biyar ne suke aiki a wurin, kuma Saje Soumana ne shugabansu. Saje Soumana ya yi shekara ashirin yana aikin kwastan a kan iyaka.

A wannan makon wata sabuwar jami'a ta zo, mai suna Samha. Saje ya ce wa sauran jami'an, "Za mu ga kamun ludayinta." Samha ba ta gane ba, sai ya bayyana mata: "Kamar yadda ake ganin yadda mace take riƙe ludayi a wurin girki, haka ake ganin yadda sabon ma'aikaci yake aiki. Kamun ludayi shi ne yadda kake gudanar da aikinka."

Wata rana da yamma wani mutum ya zo ofishin. Ya roƙi saje ya sakaya sunansa, domin yana tsoro. Saje Soumana ya ce, "Za mu sakaya sunanka, kada ka damu." Mutumin ya ce, "Wani mai fasa ƙwauri mai suna Siddo ya kitsa zai kawo buhunan shinkafa daga Nijar a daren yau. Ya kitsa ya ƙetare iyaka a lokacin wasan ƙwallon ƙafa tsakanin Najeriya da Nijar, domin yana tunanin duk jami'ai za su shagala da wasan."

Da dare wasan ya fara. Sauran jami'ai suna sauraron rediyo a cikin ofis. Saje ya ce wa Samha, "Ke za ki tsaya a bakin hanya. Idan kika ga wani abu, ki sadar da saƙo gare ni da rediyon hannu."

Bayan awa ɗaya wata amalanke da jaki yake ja ta zo daga gefen daji. Siddo ne a kanta. Amalanken cike take da akwatunan tangaran. Siddo ya ce, "Tangaran ne kawai, faranti da kofuna. Zan kai kasuwar Maradi ne." Samha ta ce, "Me ya sa za ka kai tangaran Maradi ta wannan hanya, alhali Maradi tana bayanka?"

Siddo bai amsa ba. Samha ta buɗe akwati na farko. Tangaran ne a sama, amma a ƙarƙashinsa akwai buhunan shinkafa. Ta buɗe na biyu, haka ne. Nan take ta sadar da saƙo ga saje: "Na kama shi. Akwai shinkafa a ƙarƙashin tangaran." Saje Soumana da sauran jami'ai suka zo da gudu.

A daidai lokacin rediyo ya sanar cewa wasan ya ƙare canjaras, ɗaya da ɗaya. Wani jami'i ya ce, "Kai, canjaras! Ba mu ci ba, ba mu sha kashi ba." Saje Soumana ya yi dariya ya ce, "Wasan ƙwallo ya ƙare canjaras, amma mu mun ci namu wasan a daren yau."

Washegari ya rubuta wa ofishin kwastan na jiha cewa, "Kamun ludayin sabuwar jami'a Samha ya yi kyau ƙwarai." Ya kuma tabbatar da cewa an sakaya sunan mutumin da ya ba su labari.

Tambayoyi:
Wa ne shugaban ofishin kwastan?
Saje Soumana ne shugaban ofishin.
Me ake nufi da kamun ludayi?
Ana nufin yadda mutum yake gudanar da aikinsa.
Ta yaya Samha ta sadar da saƙo ga saje?
Ta sadar da saƙo da rediyon hannu.
Me Siddo ya kitsa?
Ya kitsa ya kawo buhunan shinkafa a lokacin wasan ƙwallon ƙafa.
Me yake ƙarƙashin tangaran?
Akwai buhunan shinkafa a ƙarƙashin tangaran.
Yaya wasan ƙwallon ya ƙare?
Wasan ya ƙare canjaras, ɗaya da ɗaya.

lessons.title: Hanyar asibiti a damina
lessons.summary: Tsahara, two months a widow and keeping her mourning seclusion, leaves the house when her daughter-in-law goes into labour on a night when the flooded river has washed away the road; the family struggles through the mud, a fisherman takes them across, a boy is born at dawn, and they talk about his circumcision before Tsahara goes back to her mourning.
lessons.text:
Tsahara ta rasa mijinta watanni biyu da suka wuce. Bayan kwanaki uku na makoki, da 'yan uwa da maƙwabta suka zo gidanta suna ta'aziyya, sai ta shiga takaba. Mace mai takaba tana zama a gida watanni huɗu da kwana goma, ba ta fita sai da larura. Tsahara ta ce, "Makoki ya ƙare, amma takaba ta fara."

Ɗanta Hamdi da matarsa Naja'atu suna zaune tare da ita. Naja'atu tana da cikin wata tara. Asibiti yana wani gari a ɗayan gefen kogi, tafiyar awa ɗaya a ƙafa.

A wannan damina ruwan sama ya yi yawa. Kogin ya cika har ya fito daga hanyarsa. Ruwan ya yashe ƙasar hanya, ya tafi da gadar katako. Ruwa ya yashe gonaki da yawa a gefen kogin.

Wata dare, bayan ruwan sama mai ƙarfi, Naja'atu ta fara naƙuda. Hamdi ya fita da gudu ya kira ahalinsa: kawunsa, 'yan uwansa maza da matan gidan. Ahalin gidan duka suka taru a tsakar gida. Wani ya ce, "Ta yaya za mu kai ta asibiti? Ruwa ya yashe hanya."

Tsahara ta tashi ta ce, "Ni zan tafi da ita." Ƙanwar mijinta ta ce, "Amma kina takaba!" Tsahara ta ce, "Liman ya faɗa mana cewa larura tana halatta fita. Naƙuda larura ce. Bayan haka zan koma takabata."

Suka shimfiɗa Naja'atu a kan gado na katako, maza huɗu suka ɗauke shi. Tsahara tana gefenta riƙe da fitila. Suka yi ta faman tafiya a cikin laka. A wasu wurare ruwa ya kai gwiwa. Naƙudar Naja'atu tana ƙara ƙarfi, tana kuka. Tsahara tana ta lallashinta, "Ki yi haƙuri, mun kusa."

Da suka isa bakin kogi, sai suka ga wani masunci a cikin kwalekwalensa. Ya ce, "Na ji ana faman tafiya da mai naƙuda, shi ya sa na jira." Ya ƙetare da su zuwa ɗayan gefe. Tsahara ta ce, "Ruwa ya yashe hanya, amma Allah bai yashe mu ba."

A asibiti ungozoma ta karɓi Naja'atu. Kafin asuba ta haifi ɗa namiji lafiya. Ahalin gidan suka yi murna. Tsahara ta ce, "Za a sa masa sunan kakansa."

Ungozomar ta tambaya, "Za a yi wa jaririn kaciya a nan asibiti?" Tsahara ta ce, "A zamanin da wanzami ne yake yin kaciya a gida idan yaro ya ɗan girma." Ungozomar ta ce, "Yanzu da yawa ana yin kaciya a asibiti tun yaro yana ƙarami, domin ya fi tsabta." Hamdi ya ce, "Ahalin gida za su yi shawara a kan kaciyar."

Da gari ya waye, Tsahara ta koma gida, ta ci gaba da takabarta. Gidan da yake cikin makoki watanni biyu da suka wuce, yanzu ya cika da murna.

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe Tsahara ta shiga takaba?
Ta shiga takaba bayan kwanaki uku na makoki.
Me ruwan kogi ya yi wa hanya?
Ruwan ya yashe ƙasar hanya, ya tafi da gadar katako.
Wa Hamdi ya kira lokacin da Naja'atu ta fara naƙuda?
Ya kira ahalinsa: kawunsa, 'yan uwansa da matan gidan.
Yaya suka yi tafiya zuwa bakin kogi?
Sun yi ta faman tafiya a cikin laka, ruwa ya kai gwiwa a wasu wurare.
Me ya sa Tsahara ta fita duk da takabarta?
Domin naƙuda larura ce, kuma larura tana halatta fita.
Me ungozomar ta tambaya game da jaririn?
Ta tambaya ko za a yi masa kaciya a asibiti.
